prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds revealed in
earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only tells you how often this line type was paid at all.
- If you decide the line is indemnified and no cap, sub-limit or percentage reduction applies,
  take the stated amount as t and give a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. These
  amounts are before such policy arithmetic; apply caps and reductions on top.
- A line type that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies
  do not carry; price it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Damage assessment and inspection": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per unit about 524 (80% range 386 to 799); revealed per unit: >=481 (case 20)
- line 3 "Measurement technician": no earlier line of this grade; level of the other hourly grades; when indemnified t per hr about 60 (80% range 20 to 177), so this line (2.5 hr) about 150 (51 to 442)
- line 4 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 10 of 22 earlier cases, t = 0 in 12; when indemnified t per hr about 79 (80% range 71 to 87); revealed per hr: 37-41 (case 32*), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=74 (case 27) (* = other policy wording)
- line 8 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 10 of 22 earlier cases, t = 0 in 12; when indemnified t per unit about 79 (80% range 71 to 87); revealed per unit: 37-41 (case 32*), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=74 (case 27) (* = other policy wording)

items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers ordinary loss assessment, and the €524 gross estimate is below its €3,000 cap. Allocating the single €500 event deductible proportionally across covered charges leaves €359.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers indoor leak location; €500 for the detection work plus €150 for separately billed technician time is below the shared €1,000 cap. The proportional share of the event deductible leaves €343.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time if it is not already included in the detection fee, per §7.1.8(c). At €60 gross per hour, €150 is within the shared leak-location cap and becomes €103 after the proportional deductible allocation.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one travel charge on this contractor's invoice. The €79 gross estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT and becomes €54 after the proportional deductible allocation.

items.description: Repair two confirmed leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 treats age-related leakage as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking, and §9.1.1 does not treat ordinary ageing alone as a breach. Allowing €260 gross for the two local repairs under §7.1.1(b) leaves €178 after the proportional deductible allocation.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking; replacing them during the same visit does not make the work covered. The positive estimate is conditional on coverage contrary to the stated facts.

Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss standard, so the separately billed premium upgrade difference is not indemnified even on a covered section. The positive estimate is conditional only.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows the plumber's one vehicle charge for attending the covered joint repairs. The €79 gross estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap and becomes €54 after the proportional deductible allocation.
